subject: rror: an illegal memory access was encountered launching kernel kNLSkinTest

messages.author: Sruthi Sudhakar
messages.body:
Respected group members,
Recently I have asked about converting a DNA into mol2 format using
antechamber and was advised to directly generate the coordinate and
topology files for the same since its not an artificially modified dna. I
did that and could successfully do the minimization. But when I had done
the heating stage, the following error occurred. I tried including the
vlimit in the input script but still the error repeated.
pmemd.cuda -O -i nvt_md1.in -c dna_min2.rst7 -p dna.prmtop -o dna_nvt.out
-r dna_nvt.rst7 -x dna_nvt.nc
Error: an illegal memory access was encountered launching kernel kNLSkinTest
I have attached both the input script and the incomplete output file along.
I have tried doing the heating in small stages even then the same error
occured. Please suggest any possible solution for the same.
Thank you

messages.author: David Case
messages.body:
On Sat, Jan 18, 2020, Sruthi Sudhakar wrote:
>I tried including the
>vlimit in the input script but still the error repeated.
You have atoms in your starting structure that are almost on top of one
another. Use the "check" commands in cpptraj or parmed to tell you
which ones they are. You will need to fix this before proceeding.
Second: you should generally plan to do a minimization first before
running MD.
Third: when problems occur, use the CPU version of pmemd, set ntpr=1 and
nstlim to 100 (or so): this will provide more useful diagnostic
information.
....dac
